summary: Two segmented controls: a text-only Week/Month/Year period and a List/Grid view switch with icons.
use: Switching a view mode or time range inline above a list, chart or dashboard.
spec: Period control `aria-label="Period"` with `bind:value={period}` and 3 items: Week, Month, Year
View control `aria-label="View"` with 2 items using `icon: LayoutList` and `icon: LayoutGrid`
